observations: Pronounced broad depressions throughout the blue and green, followed by a steep rise near 600 nm and a broad red maximum. Structured continuum requires physical modelling; no feature identification is made here.
J1323: weak blue mean, steep broad rise into the green and a red plateau with a gentle decline. Native blue range crosses zero widely; use the separate IVAR/mask and fibre-position audit.
Noisy, nearly flat broad mean after a blue rise; several isolated large red native excursions and a red-edge mean depression remain. Unanchored Fnu conversion is verified but precision is limited.
Recovered spectrum has a broad maximum around the middle of the visible range and a gentle red decline. Native blue and red excursions cross zero despite the smooth mean.
Broad rise from the blue to an early green maximum, followed by a gradual decline; a narrow middle depression survives the 40 A means. Grey native range is much wider at the blue edge.
Broad, almost level central continuum with a shallow red decline and small narrow dips. Unanchored shape remains a calibration caution; no unique line cause follows from the panel.
Blue depression followed by a broad peak and a long shallower red shoulder. Mean remains positive, while the blue native range is strongly negative in places.
Broad green hump with several depressions across its red side, then a gradual red decline. This is the LHS2534 record identified in the input; visual greenness is not a novelty assessment.
A sequence of deep broad troughs dominates the blue and green, with a smoother red decline. Fnu conversion preserves this resolved structure and the native envelope is relatively narrow.
Very wide positive and negative native range at the blue edge compresses an almost flat low-amplitude mean. Reference S/N is below two; the small positive Duv requires a strong quality caution.
Several rounded troughs across the blue-to-green plateau; the red end falls smoothly. Native red excursions remain visible beyond the mean.
Alternating strong troughs and peaks in the blue and green, with a broad higher red continuum after the last central feature. No atomic or instrumental cause is inferred.
Broad rise to a green maximum and steady decline into the red. The native blue range is substantial and includes negative values; the positive Duv is a screen metric only.
Recovered curve has a noisy blue depression, a modest green hump and a declining red shoulder. Wide native excursions exceed the mean over much of the panel.
A smooth broad turnover with decreasing red flux; weak central depressions and an increasingly wide red native range. No singular large interior peak stands out.
Strong high blue continuum drops into several deep broad troughs; a red rise and maximum follow. The transition is conspicuous but the panel alone cannot assign its origin.
Low blue continuum rises to a broad local maximum, then shows several middle depressions and a declining red tail. Native blue scatter is relatively wide.
Very high blue continuum falls into a deep wide blue-green depression, then rises to a modest red shoulder. Structured broad suppression survives the Fnu conversion.
Recovered mean has a small blue trough, broad plateau and gradual red decline. A narrow positive middle feature is visible near a marked sky region; no cause assigned.
Several sharp blue troughs followed by an extended central plateau and slow red decline. Negative native values are confined mainly to the blue edge.
Broad maximum shortly after the blue depression, declining toward the red. Large native blue excursions and a few negative red excursions remain despite a smooth mean.
Broad hump in the blue-green region, with a gentle red decline. An isolated high native blue spike and a broad red native envelope deserve source-level attention.
Two conspicuous broad dips bracket a blue-green local maximum and a shallower green plateau. Native blue negatives are much larger than the smoothed mean.
Alternating deep troughs and high peaks dominate the blue and green; the red continuum is smoother and elevated. The low reference S/N widens the native range around each feature.
Several extremely narrow high native peaks dominate the vertical scale, while the mean stays much lower. Reference S/N is low; individual-pixel flags are needed before interpreting peaks.
Very steep blue-to-red decline with broad negative excursions at both ends. The unanchored Fnu-corrected mean approaches zero in the red and has low S/N.
Broad early maximum with relatively flat middle continuum and gradual red decline. Native blue excursions cross zero, while the red mean is smoother.
Fairly flat broad blue-green plateau, then smooth decline toward the red. Several narrow downward excursions survive the display aggregation.
Sharp rise through multiple blue troughs into a maximum, followed by a long red decline. Structured features are distinct from the native envelope; no line identifications attempted.
Recovered blue trough and low broad continuum with a red decline. A very large native blue-edge positive excursion controls much of the vertical range.

Recovered spectrum rises from a blue dip to a broad plateau and then declines. Native blue negatives and positive excursions dominate the edge; middle continuum is comparatively smooth.
Broad downward blue trend with repeated troughs and a flatter red shoulder. Large native red negative excursions and S/N about 2.5 limit fine-shape interpretation.
Unit is verified but the colour is explicitly unavailable/ineligible. Native flux spans large positive and negative ranges, and the mean is close to zero or negative over most of the window.
